messages:
Alex: Heads-up — I’m on a delayed flight but we just got a p95 latency spike on inference-prod (US-west). I need someone to take primary for ~4h while I’m offline. Current prim=me. ETA for me on Slack ~3h. Can anyone swing an expedited prim/sec swap? :airplane:

IncidentBot: [ALERT] inference-prod latency anomaly detected. p50=45ms -> 120ms, p95=250ms -> 820ms. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Pager triggered. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/company/INC-2026-1423

Priya: I can take primary for the next 4h. I’m in PST and available. Will need Sam as secondary unless Jordan can shadow for the 02:00–04:00 UTC gap.

Alex: Priya — thank you. Quick handoff notes:
- Primary responsibilities: own the pager, runbook triage, coordinate fallback to canary/quantized model variants.
- Key telemetry: Console > Inference > latency, KV cache hit ratio, autoscaler queue length.
- If canary rollback needed, run the canary rollback script (link below) then confirm traffic is back under 200ms p95.

Runbook snippet (copy/paste):
```
1) Check dashboards: https://redwood.company/console/metrics?panel=inference-latency
2) Check KV cache: curl -s https://infra-metrics/cache | jq .hit_ratio
3) Restart canary pool: ./infra/restart_canary.sh --pool=canary-inference --reason="latency-spike"
4) If >30min w/o improvement -> escalate to infra-oncall (@oncall-infra) and consider model-fallback to quantized-v1
```

Sam: I’ll be secondary. I’ll also open a short watch doc and add a few quick prompts to validate quality if we roll back to quantized-v1.

Jordan: FYI, I’m offline 02:00–04:00 UTC but can shadow remote at 01:30 UTC to catch issues before that window. If Priya needs extra hands during that gap, tag me and I’ll hop on.

Priya: Taking it now. I’ll first confirm current canary status and KV hit ratio, then start a shallow regen test on /v1/generate to measure end-to-end. Acknowledge by Sam?

Sam: Ack. I swapped pager assignment to Priya in PagerDuty (ID: PD-9876). I also created a quick check script in ops/tmp/latency-smoke.sh. Running smoke now.

OpsBot: Canary rollout auto-detection flagged a high tail latency. Canary pool: canary-inference-3, health=DEGRADED. Autoscaler paused due to throttling. Recommendation: manual restart of canary pool.

Priya: First checks done: KV hit ratio 0.62 (normal ~0.8), canary node 3 restarted (rolled back to previous image), p95 dropped from 820ms -> 210ms within ~6 minutes. Running quality smoke now (10 sample prompts).

Alex: Thanks team — I’ll hand off official notes in the oncall doc later, but for now Priya is primary, Sam is secondary, Jordan shadowing 01:30–02:00 UTC then offline 02:00–04:00 UTC, Alex offline until ~3h from root_ts.

Priya: Confirmed primary takeover. I’ll keep the thread updated every 15m until handback. Quick checklist for whoever takes back primary: 1) confirm p95 under 250ms for 30m, 2) KV hit_ratio back to >=0.75, 3) roll forward any canary fixes if needed. Link to handoff template: https://redwood.company/runbooks/oncall-handoff

Sam: Adding watch doc link: https://docs.redwood/company/watch/INC-2026-1423-smoke. Also leaving notes about prompt set used for quality checks.

Jordan: Noted. If anything regresses during 02:00–04:00 UTC ping @Jordan and I’ll wake on-call if needed. :+1:

Alex: Thanks everyone — Priya, Sam: appreciate the fast swap. I’ll DM any remaining context and the travel ETA.

IncidentBot: [UPDATE] Incident assigned to Priya. Alert suppressed for acknowledged pager. Next automated check in 5m.

Priya: Final note before I dig in: if we do a model-variant fallback, prefer quantized-v1 (latency win, small quality regression). Sam, prepare the evaluation prompts in the watch doc so we can spot regressions quickly.

Sam: On it. Going to run the 10-sample smoke, will post results here in ~3m. :coffee:

Priya: Swap confirmed and active. I’ll post a 15m status update or sooner if anything changes.
